title.zh: Aave Freezes V3 and V4 Markets After Binance Exploiter Deposits $60M USDT and Bo
title.en: Aave Freezes V3 and V4 Markets After Binance Exploiter Deposits $60M USDT and Bo

current_state.zh: Aave froze every DAO-operated V3 and V4 market after a wallet linked to the Binance exploiter deposited about 60 million USDT and borrowed 19,762 WETH (roughly $44.6M) minutes earlier, with the position still open but over-collateralized and Aave's contracts reportedly unaffected.
